candidates.title: Lula or Bolsonaro: Why Brazil's presidential election matters for Brics and India
candidates.excerpt: Brics began with five members and grew to eleven after the 2024 expansion, with Indonesia the newest, joining in 2025. Brazil opposed the enlargement, particularly because of the one nation. Iran. It feared that adding the avowedly anti-West Islamic Republic would cost the group its cohesion. Like India, Brazil wants Brics to be reformist and not revolutionary, thereby limiting it to a body that argues for change inside the existing order rather than one that tries to replace it.

candidates.title: Seven arrested for illegal transportation of explosives in Adilabad
candidates.excerpt: Adilabad police arrested seven persons for allegedly transporting explosives from Uttar Pradesh to Telangana. They seized 20,000 electronic detonators, 90 boosters, two vehicles and six mobile phones worth Rs 20 lakh. Two others were booked for their alleged roles.

candidates.title: Four arrested for gambling on Mancherial outskirts
candidates.excerpt: Task Force personnel arrested four persons for allegedly gambling on the outskirts of Mancherial on Wednesday night. Police seized Rs 40,300 in cash, three mobile phones and a scooter. The accused were handed over to Mancherial police for further action.

candidates.title: Ghatkesar SHO suspended over corruption allegations
candidates.excerpt: Ghatkesar SHO M Balaswamy has been suspended following an inquiry into alleged corruption and interference in two investigations. The inspector allegedly accepted bribes in a Kondapur land dispute and a young woman’s suicide case, sources said.

candidates.title: Kumaraswamy slams Karnataka government over questioning of JD(S) workers
candidates.excerpt: H D Kumaraswamy has voiced strong concerns about the Karnataka government allegedly targeting JD(S) members after a supposed sting operation. He reported that a party worker was detained at an undisclosed place without legal notice. Kumaraswamy staged a protest outside the police commissioner's office and expressed his willingness to be investigated, raising issues of biased investigations against opposition figures and social media actions.

candidates.title: NEET-PG 2026: SC issues notice on plea seeking candidate-wise disclosure of questions, options, and answers
candidates.excerpt: A Bench of Justices P.S. Narasimha and Alok Aradhe issued notice to the Union of India, the NBEMS, and the National Medical Commission (NMC), and tagged the matter with pending petitions concerning the NEET-PG examination.
